name: Colorado
year: 2026 license year (big game seasons from CPW's 2025-2029 season structure)
summary: Colorado has the largest elk herd in the country and about 23 million acres of public land, mostly national forest and BLM in the western two-thirds. Most deer, pronghorn, moose and many elk licenses come through the spring draw with preference points. Over-the-counter elk licenses are rifle-only in OTC units, and OTC whitetail and bear licenses are also sold.
publicNote: Everyone 18-64 who hunts needs the annual Habitat Stamp. On State Wildlife Areas you must carry a valid hunting or fishing license (or an SWA pass). State Trust Land is open only where it's enrolled in the Public Access Program, mostly Sept 1 - end of Feb.

fees.note: Nonresident licenses are sold as a big game + fishing combo. Prices change each year with inflation: verify in CPW Shop.

rules: Big game licenses come from the spring draw (preference points) or over the counter where offered. OTC elk licenses are rifle-only and good in OTC units for the 2nd and 3rd rifle seasons.
Anyone born on or after Jan 1, 1949 needs hunter education.
Rifle season hunters must wear at least 500 sq in of daylight fluorescent orange or pink above the waist, visible from all sides, plus an orange or pink head covering.
Leftover and OTC licenses go on sale in early August (Aug 4 in 2026); the secondary draw closes in late June.
Some units require mandatory chronic wasting disease (CWD) testing of harvested deer or elk; check your unit in the brochure.
State Trust Land is closed to hunting unless it's enrolled in the Public Access Program.

rut: Elk bugle and breed mid-September to early October, peaking in late September. Mule deer rut runs mid-November to early December, so the 4th rifle season (Nov 18-22) catches it.

nr.note: Most deer units are draw-only. OTC whitetail licenses exist in a few eastern units.
